text:
Anil: heads up — saw a regression in p50->p99 after we flipped the AWQ path for Mixtral-8x on dedicated pools this morning. p50 fine, but tail jumps ~2.3x.
Sara: hmm, which workload? long-chat or short completion?
Anil: mostly short completions (seq<=128) but with a heavy hit when kv cache misses spike. looks like microbatch steering + kv-prefetch interactions.
Diego: can you dump the hotset stats? I suspect the kv hotset ratio oscillates and triggers spill/evict thrash.
Anil: pasted from telemetry: `kv_hotset_ratio=0.18 -> 0.62` over 120s window during the spike, kv-evict rate increased ~4x, microbatch latency jumps on those requests.
Mei: that matches the repro I had on Qwen14B earlier. AWQ kernels are faster per-token but have less tolerant memory layout for incremental cache growth. Might be causing extra memcpy paths.
perf-bot: new trace uploaded: https://perf.redwood/traces/2140894321 (flame + memcalls)
Sara: looked at the trace — big scatter around `kv_copy_to_gpu` plus `kernel_launch` stalls. Also a few `fallback_fp8_conv` invocations.
Diego: fallback_fp8_conv? we didn't expect FP8 fallbacks on Mixtral-8x for short seqs. is that from kernel selector heuristics?
Mei: yes, selector currently chooses `awq_gemm_fast` for layers with head_dim<=64. But if memory alignment fails (misaligned strides during incremental kv growth) it falls back to `fp8_conv` which is more expensive on our HW.
Anil: proposed short-term mitigation: disable the AWQ fast path for Mixtral when kv_hotset_ratio > 0.4 or when tail_seq_ratio > 0.25. That avoids the misaligned-copy fallback.
Sara: can we instead make the selector prefer `aligned_gemm` over `fp8_conv` when evictions are high? cheaper to change selector than revert AWQ.
Diego: possible. Also we should tweak batching heuristic: when hotset oscillation detected, reduce microbatch budget from 8->4 to limit concurrent KV growth. That reduces throughput but should flatten p99.
Mei: QA notes from calibration: calib-suite-v3 (300 prompts across long/short/multi-turn) shows AWQ accuracy delta vs GPTQ: perplexity +0.8%, EM -0.35% on Mixtral. Not terrible but visible. Calibration prompts where output contains many rare tokens amplify errors.
Anil: accuracy tradeoff is acceptable if latency stable. ops will complain if p99 spikes.
perf-bot: perf test run 2140894400: baseline->AWQ-on shows p50 18ms -> 15ms, p99 110ms -> 255ms (kv spike windows)
Sara: can we instrument a KV-prefetch gating metric in runtime? gate = (hotset_ratio * active_mb / gpu_slots) and if > threshold, switch kernel policy and microbatch throttle.
Diego: I like gate. threshold tuning: start with 0.3 and iterate. Add a 10s hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping.
Mei: also add a quick memcopy path that tries `aligned_memcpy` then `unaligned_memcpy` with a failfast count — avoid full fallback into fp8 kernel. Should cut the worst stalls.
Anil: small repro script for bench (put in thread):
```
# repro microbatch kv thrash
python perf/repro_kv_thrash.py --model mixtral-8x --seq 128 --batch 6 --microbatch 8 --awq true --duration 300
```
Diego: thanks, will run on dedicated pool `d-3` and post traces.
Sara: action items: 1) Diego run repro + trace, 2) Mei implement aligned-memcopy fastpath + metrics, 3) Anil add KV-prefetch gate + hysteresis to selector, 4) Ops: hold AWQ rollout for Mixtral until next patch.
eng-runtime-oncall: noted, will pause rollout in region eu-west and revert to awq=off for new pods.
Anil: also adding a passive experiment: collect `first_kv_touch_seq` histogram by model+head_dim to inform better head-aware kernel selection.
Mei: one more datapoint — for layers with head_dim>=128, AWQ path is stable and wins. so selector must be asymmetric by head_dim.
Diego: running the bench now, will drop link to traces in ~10m.
perf-bot: next scheduled perf-run 2140898000 will include the KV gating metric if PR lands before 2140896500.
Sara: thanks team. keep notes short in the PR so support can revert fast if needed. :thumbsup:
Diego: trace uploaded: https://perf.redwood/traces/2140894667 — initial look: kv_copy thrash + two fallback_fp8_conv spikes at 2140894501 and 2140894538.
Anil: perfect, I'll start the selector patch and ping when ready for canary.
Mei: I'll send the aligned-memcopy PR later today.
eng-runtime-oncall: monitoring alert thresholds temporarily bumped to avoid noisy pages while we patch.
Sara: good. follow-up meeting tomorrow 10am to review perf numbers and decide on rollout.
